identificationModule.briefTitle: Clinical Study of the Efficacy and Safety of BCD-178 and Perjeta® as Neoadjuvant Therapy of HER2-Positive Breast Cancer
identificationModule.officialTitle: A Double-Blind, Randomized Clinical Study of the Efficacy and Safety of BCD-178 and Perjeta® as Neoadjuvant Therapy of HER2-Positive Breast Cancer

descriptionModule.briefSummary:
The goal of this study is to compare the efficacy and safety of BCD-178 and Perjeta as neoadjuvant therapy for HER2-positive breast cancer.

Subjects with histologically confirmed diagnosis of HER2-positive invasive breast cancer (stage II-III, tumor size \> 2 cm), with no estrogen (ER) and progesterone (PR) receptors will be randomized to one of two treatment groups (BCD-178 group or Perjeta group) in a 1:1 ratio.

armGroups.label: BCD-178 group
armGroups.description: Neoadjuvant therapy stage (6 cycles, 18 weeks): BCD-178, Trastuzumab, Docetaxel, Carboplatin; Surgical treatment; Adjuvant therapy stage (up to 12 months of HER2-targeted therapy in total): BCD-178, Trastuzumab

armGroups.label: Perjeta Group
armGroups.description: Neoadjuvant therapy stage (6 cycles, 18 weeks): Perjeta, Trastuzumab, Docetaxel, Carboplatin; Surgical treatment; Adjuvant therapy stage (up to 12 months of HER2-targeted therapy in total): BCD-178, Trastuzumab

interventions.name: BCD-178
interventions.description: at an initial dose of 840 mg (1 cycle), then 420 mg

interventions.name: Perjeta
interventions.description: at an initial dose of 840 mg (1 cycle), then 420 mg

primaryOutcomes.measure: To compare the efficacy of BCD-178 and Perjeta as neoadjuvant therapy by studying the total pathological complete response (tpCR) rate

secondaryOutcomes.description: the ORR according to RECIST 1.1 criteria
Proportion of subjects with breast-conserving surgery

Proportion of subjects with adverse reactions; Proportion of subjects with CTCAE 5.0 grade 3 or higher adverse reactions; • Proportion of subjects with serious adverse reactions; • Proportion of subjects who prematurely discontinued neoadjuvant therapy due to adverse reactions
Proportion of subjects with binding and neutralizing antibodies
Cmin - minimum observed product concentration ; Ceoi - concentration at the end of each infusion
